facts.fact: 第二个工作日的下午：农场工作每天七点半开始，赶在佛州酷暑前；叙述者在给文件建档案时频频走神到 Mama  Closet 墙上的话「The devil’s inside」，因偏离查清 Gazzie 做了什么的原定任务而愧疚。
facts.anchor: The devil’s inside. I still didn’t know what Gazzie had done to make my mother write such desperate phrases and was beginning to feel guilty that I’d strayed from my quest to figure it out.

facts.fact: Harrison 推开半开的门给叙述者送咖啡，穿 Greer Fine Alligators 背心 T 和 bootcut 牛仔裤；她把伞柄递过来的姿态；叙述者认定 Harrison 是靠谄媚让外婆把帝国遗嘱给他的 weasel，一秒都不信他。
facts.anchor: One hand cupped a coffee mug, handle extended toward me.

facts.fact: Harrison 问她打算待多久，语气里透出急切；叙述者由此明白咖啡的真正目的是探她是否要争遗产、会不会挑战他，她只回「Not sure yet」，不让他轻松拿到答案。
facts.anchor: So that’s why he’d brought me the coffee. He wanted to know if I was trying to inherit the farm, if I would challenge him.

facts.fact: 叙述者去休息室拿 half-and-half，Nova 坐在圆桌边，看见 Harrison 时笑容冻住；叙述者猜测 Nova 要么想把 Harrison 独享，要么是 Gazzie 吩咐过把她隔离在档案洞里、Nova 担心这成了一次违规。
facts.anchor: In the break room, Nova sat at the single circular table.

facts.fact: 叙述者装作渴望内情的 damsels in distress 哄 Harrison 带她参观；Harrison 用皮带环上的钥匙开门，进入 processing spaces——宰杀与剥皮的官方统称，走廊两侧依次是 slaughtering room、skinning room、skin salting、skin storage；露趾拖鞋不许进。
facts.anchor: explaining that we were entering the processing spaces—the official term for alligator killing and skinning

facts.fact: 屠宰间（约两间教室大、水泥墙地坡向中央排水口、门上方挂着另一幅 Ida 画像）里，Gazzie 与前一天见过的瘦山羊胡男人拖进嘴缠 duct tape 的鳄鱼；Gazzie 抄起棒球棍猛击其头部，血溅上白衬衫，鳄鱼不动但眼睛睁着——只是被震晕。
facts.anchor: she raised it above the alligator’s head and slammed it down, blood spraying across her shirt

facts.fact: Harrison 低声解释 Gazzie 在切断脊髓，标准做法应是 captive bolt——一种向颅骨发射金属杆、更无痛的工具，但 Gazzie 嫌它不传统；鳄鱼没死透拖着脚爬向墙，Gazzie 追过去再次挥棍。
facts.anchor: We have one, but Gazzie says it’s not traditional, so.

facts.fact: 叙述者问骨头去哪（触发点是 Mama 墙上的话），Harrison 答留部分头骨其余扔掉，并以「Show’s over, Miss Greer」赶人，她纠正「It’s Beaumont」；临出门时 Gazzie 面向 Ida Greer 画像低头一瞬，像在祈祷。
facts.anchor: For a breath—only a breath, no longer—she bowed her head, like she was praying.
